entries.text: StarRocks has tuned templates for TPC-H and SSB.
StarRocks supports the statistics phase, which gathers full optimizer statistics after loading.
The local StarRocks Docker stack moves from StarRocks 3.5.16 to 4.1.8.
Fixed StarRocks results recording the MySQL compatibility version (8.0.33) instead of the StarRocks version.
Fixed tuned StarRocks runs failing to clear earlier tuning metadata, because StarRocks rejects DELETE with WHERE TRUE.
